title: Implement lighting/color characteristic mappings (K.3.5)
description:
Add to gatt_ipso.c static table, lighting/color characteristics:

- Illuminance 0x2AFB -> 3301/5700, lux
- Chromaticity Coordinates 0x2AE4 -> 3335/5701, 1
- Color Temperature 0x2AE5 -> 3311/5706, K
- Luminous Intensity 0x2AFF -> 3311/5700, cd
- Luminous Flux 0x2AFE -> 3311/5701, lm
- Luminous Energy 0x2AFD -> 3331/5700, lm*s
- Luminous Exposure 0x2AFC -> 26259/5700, lx*s
- CIE xy Coordinates 0x2AE3 -> 3335/5701, 1

~8 entries. Reference: spec/appendix-gatt-ipso.md K.3.5
